# llmdoc

> Persistent external context for codebases. llmdoc preserves architecture, constraints, rationale, contracts, non-obvious failures, and risky workflows that source code cannot cheaply reconstruct.

Canonical site: https://llmdoc.tokenroll.ai/
Repository: https://github.com/TokenRollAI/llmdoc

## CLI

Treat llmdoc as external tooling. Do not add it to the consumer project's package.json or lockfile.

    npx -y @tokenroll/llmdoc tree

To inspect the current repository's document structure, relations, and status in a browser, start the local-only Viewer. It binds to 127.0.0.1.

    npx -y @tokenroll/llmdoc serve

Always use the full scoped package name. A bare npx llmdoc resolves to an unrelated package.
